powerName: Exercise Section 9 powers beyond the exclusive economic zone in a defined pursuit circumstance
description: Section 9(5) states that where, in pursuance of the commission of an offence under the Act, a foreign vessel is pursued beyond the limits of the exclusive economic zone of India, the powers conferred on an authorised officer by Section 9 may be exercised beyond those limits in the circumstances and to the extent recognised by international law and State practice.
conditions: The circumstance must involve pursuit in pursuance of the commission of an offence under the Act.
The vessel must have been pursued beyond the limits of the exclusive economic zone of India.
The circumstances and extent must be recognised by international law and State practice.
limitations: This record does not determine the maritime zone or whether the international-law condition is met.
This record does not calculate jurisdiction from distance.
source: India Code, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
